turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail:
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
Orders currently take an average of 1–2 business days to process before shipping. For the contiguous U.S., standard transit then takes about 1–3 days to the West Coast, 3–4 days to the Central U.S., 4–5 days to the Midwest, or 5–7 days to the East Coast. These are estimates, not guaranteed delivery dates.
You’ll receive a tracking email when your order is ready to ship. You can check the latest times on our Delivery Information page.

What's your return and refund policy?
For orders placed on our website, we accept returns for a full refund within 90 days of purchase if the item is in good condition. We ask that you keep a Cat Exercise Wheel for at least 30 days to give your cat time to get used to it; returning one sooner incurs a $30-per-box return-label fee.
Wheels and Giant Scratching Towers need to be cleaned, disassembled, and returned in their original box to qualify for a prepaid return label within the contiguous U.S. If you no longer have the box, you can still return an eligible item at your own shipping expense. Return shipping for accessories and for orders outside the contiguous U.S. is also your responsibility. Original shipping fees are not refundable.
We issue the item refund once we receive and inspect the return. You can read the full returns and refunds policy here.
